label: daily-unwrap-conversion-error-loki-defaults
description: Unwrap range metrics without an error filter: the metric's own VictoriaLogs stats query counts the values the unwrap conversion rejects (Loki fails the query with SampleExtractionErr) in groups of their own, and only a hit costs a bounded lookup. E1-E5, E8 and E9 hold only numbers, so they measure the counter's cost on the common path (clean queries must stay within noise of main at every range); E6 and E7 hold values Loki rejects (a unit string, hexadecimal ids), so main answers 200 and the branch answers Loki's 400. Run with the control set.
